title: Jarrah, Wood Lathes, Dust, 3D Printing & Shed Legends
description: In this episode Plummo & Hazy let fly with a shed full of Jarrah, wood lathes, 3D printing, sanding tips and enough Aussie banter to keep the splinters laughing.

title: EP04 — Jigs, Gigs and Heart Rigs
description: Fire up the shed and join Plummo & Hazy for another ripper episode of The Timber Bros Podcast—packed with timber, tools, workshop banter, Aussie laughs, and a powerful Heartwood yarn with original Yellow Wiggle Greg Page about heart health, resilience, and looking after the one tool you can’t replace.

title: EP03 — Timber & Tall Ships - Huon Pine Gold
description: A raw and honest chat about ancient Huon Pine timbers from Tassie and it being used in the building of the STS Young Endeavour Tall ship with offcuts being made into luxury pens. We talk Japanese saws, Aussie Hardwoods and an honest chat about alcohol consumption.

title: EP02 — Sawdust, Routers & Real Talk
description: We dive into episode two with a chart about routers, finishes and practical tips and tricks and share our experiences in the shed and get inside our own heads. We also chat Diabaetes which is a siletn killer in Australia and the globe.

title: EP01 — Measure Twice, Cut Once, Talk Anytime
description: In our inaugural episode and the commencement of a podcast era join Plummo and Hazy as we chat all things timber, mens health with a lot of larrikin mixed in.

title: Hard Wood, Hard Lessons - The Gidgee Episode
description: What happens when you put timber through university, throw a chunk of Gidgee at a lathe, spend half your life sanding it, and then realise you probably should have gone to the gym? Welcome back to The Timber Bros Podcast with Plummo & Hazy — where woodworking, timber, tools, projects and the occasional workshop disaster all get thrown into the same bloody shed. This episode is a ripper.
